action.content: Write a song about Layton, making sure to use the letter "a" at most once.
action.label: context

action.content:
(Verse 1)
In London's streets, a lone figure's found
Eyes locked on a mysterious box, unbound
Professor Layton's mind starts to spin
Unraveling clues, the puzzle within

(Chorus)
Layton's on the case, with logic so bright
Solving mysteries, through day and night
He's got the skills, to crack the test
Unraveling secrets, and doing his best

(Verse 2)
With Luke by his side, they take on the quest
Through streets and alleys, they search for the best
A cryptic message, leads them to a clue
Unraveling the mystery, as they see it through

(Chorus)
Layton's on the case, with logic so bright
Solving mysteries, through day and night
He's got the skills, to crack the test
Unraveling secrets, and doing his best

(Bridge)
From London to Paris, to Tokyo's streets
Layton's on the move, with his puzzle skills to meet
He's got the talent, to solve the crime
And bring justice to the world, in no time

(Chorus)
Layton's on the case, with logic so bright
Solving mysteries, through day and night
He's got the skills, to crack the test
Unraveling secrets, and doing his best
